description:
Replace the ring crate with wolfcrypt-ring-compat, a drop-in ring-API-compatible crate backed by wolfCrypt. This is the FIPS 140-3 path for stoa.

## What wolfcrypt-ring-compat is

Local copy at ~/WORK/wolfssl-rs/wolfcrypt-ring-compat. Exports lib name 'ring' — transparent drop-in replacement for briansmith/ring. Downstream code uses 'use ring::...' unchanged. Swap is a Cargo [patch] entry only, no source changes required.

License: GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-wolfSSL-commercial
Version: 1.16.5 (tracks ring versioning)
FIPS feature: wolfcrypt-ring-compat/fips activates wolfCrypt FIPS 140-3 validated build (Certificate #4718, active, expires 2029-07-10)

## Migration

Workspace Cargo.toml patch:
  [patch.crates-io]
  ring = { path = "path/to/wolfcrypt-ring-compat" }

Non-FIPS build (dev/CI):
  ring = { ..., features = ["non-fips"] }

FIPS build (production):
  ring = { ..., features = ["fips"] }

No source changes to stoa or to rustls — ring API is identical.

## Spike goals

1. Verify wolfcrypt-ring-compat at version 1.16.5 is API-compatible with the ring version currently in Cargo.lock
2. Verify cargo test --workspace passes with the patch applied (non-fips feature first)
3. Verify FIPS feature builds cleanly (requires wolfSSL FIPS C library installed)
4. Document any gaps or version mismatches found
5. Check wolfcrypt-ring-compat publication status — currently at ~/WORK/wolfssl-rs, docs.rs link suggests it may be published; verify

## IMPORTANT

wolfcrypt-ring-compat MUST NOT coexist with ring in the same dependency tree — they export the same library name and will collide. The [patch] approach replaces ring globally including in rustls and all transitive dependencies.

## Constraint

stoa-6oce0 (cleanup: remove glob_matches heap alloc, adopt install_ring_provider consistently) should be cancelled or updated — install_ring_provider centralises ring initialisation but if ring is being replaced entirely that function becomes wolfcrypt initialisation or disappears. Do not clean up ring usage in stoa-6oce0 until this spike resolves the backend question.
title: spike: replace ring with wolfcrypt-ring-compat for FIPS path
